corrections.detail: External AI explicitly could not inspect the four GitHub references. This adjudication uses D142, D146 and D147 fetched directly from the connected repository.

External tally is internally inconsistent: '維持6' enumerates 7 IDs (A1,A2,B1,C2,C5,D1,D5), '修正7' enumerates 8 IDs (A3,A4,B2,B4,B5,C3,C4,D4); mixed verdicts are not mutually exclusive. Do not use category totals.
The suggested new B3 'personal life choice' was present as old B06 (residence/work) and as D146 B06 revised to a cohabiting decision. Coverage restoration, not a wholly novel conceptual direction.
Majority vote vs unanimity is governance mechanism preference and cannot be equated with personal autonomy vs relational consensus.
Presence/specificity of future goals is a background covariate, not a scored C-axis pole and not a separate scored 3-item facet by default.
External C-3 wording 'event this week only vs future preparation' gives only present pole time scarcity and replicates D142 C-BK13 defect, unlike paired C-FU14/C-FU15.
New method vs polishing old method restates D04, which D142 excluded as OUT_OF_CONSTRUCT; also reversal of left/right orientation from original D exploration left / depth right.
Middle-of-task and after-milestone choices need not be identical; retain as a contrast for a cognitive trial, not two validated independent scored factors.
Same functionality and price for tool replacement do not eliminate sunk cost, disposal, environmental concerns, familiarity, or experience confounds.
D147 explicitly defined observation contexts, not independent psychometric factors, so redundancy claims should address content coverage and item dependence rather than impose facet independence.

overall: Pursue a 4-context-per-axis comparison blueprint, NOT automatic adoption of external 4-facet solution. Retain original D147 and 50/30 fixed policy. Preserve B/C/E independent ratings as separate research; do not map them into type scoring.
